name: Microsoft 365 SharePoint site usage detail report

unsupportedVariants.description: Microsoft 365 admin center exports in MB are rounded and not byte-faithful; download the Graph CSV in bytes instead.

coverage.statement: Rows are the sites Microsoft included in this report snapshot; the file is not a tenant-wide exhaustive site inventory.

limits.description: Missing rows never prove that a site was deleted or never existed; the list can differ from the admin center Active sites list.
When report concealment is enabled, owner names and URLs are replaced by hashes; such fields are counted and not converted.
Site URLs can be blank under Customer Key (BYOK) or Customer Lockbox; blank URLs stay unknown.
Microsoft usage reports typically lag 24 to 48 hours; the observation date is the report refresh date, not the upload date.
Owner links resolve only through an Entra user UPN valid at the report refresh date; group-owned sites stay pending.
Files whose rows span more than one SharePoint root host (multi-geo) are rejected.
The report carries no permissions, sharing links, group membership or sensitivity labels.

source.name: Microsoft Graph usage report getSharePointSiteUsageDetail (CSV)
endpoints: GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/reports/getSharePointSiteUsageDetail(period='D7') (D7, D30, D90 or D180) or (date=YYYY-MM-DD); 302 redirect to a short-lived CSV download URL
roles: Delegated access: Global Administrator, Exchange Administrator, SharePoint Administrator, Skype for Business (Lync) Administrator, Teams Service Administrator, Teams Communications Administrator or Reports Reader
Global Reader and Usage Summary Reports Reader see tenant-level summaries only and cannot download user-level detail
